remarks: Stunning sun-filled 2-bedroom, 1-bath end unit fully renovated in 2021 with designer finishes throughout. Bright and airy with hardwood floors and incredible natural light flowing through every room from three exposures. The chef-inspired kitchen features custom cabinetry and newer stainless steel appliances, paired with a full-size, newer full size washer and dryer for true convenience. Both bedrooms offer excellent light and comfort, and the beautifully updated bathroom provides a sleek, spa-like feel. Enjoy indoor-outdoor living with a private balcony perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Additional storage includes a pull down attic plus shared basement space. Minutes to downtown Greenwich's upscale boutiques, shoppes, dining, and Metro-North train station.
